### Added

- (agent-platform) [Agents per tenant, tenant picker and RBAC-aware actions](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3161) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — The Agents tab lists the agents of every tenant you may read, with `Tenant` and `Created by` filters. Creating an agent asks for its tenant, an agent's page shows `Edit` and `Delete` only where you may use them, and a refused session start names the agent's tenant.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.11.1...v3.12.0
